mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (3-month change > 0) compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that prompts further rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deepening economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and INDPRO < 100.0.
